environment.description: Same EC2 instance and Flask application deployed behind an ALB in us-east-1. The ALB has a listener rule at priority 1 with a condition of type 'source-ip' matching a CIDR list maintained in an internal parameter store reference. The condition set includes 10.200.0.0/16 (corporate egress NAT pool), 172.20.4.0/23 (VPN concentrator subnet), and 198.51.100.64/28 (partner API gateway egress). The default action for the listener (priority last) is a fixed-response returning 403 with body 'Unauthorized origin'. The ALB access logs are shipped to S3 with a 5-minute delivery SLA. The EC2 instance security group only allows inbound from the ALB security group on port 8080, and the VPC has no internet gateway route for the instance subnet (egress via NAT gateway only). No WAF is attached. No rate limiting is configured at the ALB layer.

config.vpc_routing: no IGW on instance subnet, NAT gateway for egress only
